name: api-migration
prompt:
You are a backend lead planning the migration of a public REST API from version 1 to version 2 without breaking existing clients. Write a migration plan of about 400 words with these parts: Goals, Compatibility rules, Step-by-step rollout, Client communication, Rollback and Risks. Name concrete steps, put them in order and give each step a rough duration in weeks.

Current API (v1):
GET /v1/orders returns a JSON array of orders with the fields id, customer_name, total_cents and status.
POST /v1/orders accepts the same fields except id and returns 201.
Errors are plain text with HTTP status 400 or 500.
Authentication uses a shared key in the X-Api-Key header.

Target API (v2):
GET /v2/orders returns an object with a data array and a next_cursor field instead of a bare array.
Order fields are renamed to order_id, customer and total, and a currency code is added.
Errors are JSON objects with code and message.
Authentication uses bearer tokens.

About 40 percent of the traffic comes from mobile apps that update slowly, so v1 must keep working for at least six months after v2 is released.
